name: SERVICE REMOTE
overview: The full works at the press of a button. User remote control RC7 KNX for Presence Control PRO presence detectors and motion detectors in conjunction with KNX interface.
notes: Due to the rapid development in LED technology the performance values, power consumption and lumen output levels stated above are subject to change without prior notice.
